//: DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE unless you know what you are doing.
This is the LibreLane configuration LibreLane runs for this project.
The shuttle's tt_tool.py merges it with its own generated config
(DIE_AREA, FP_DEF_TEMPLATE, VDD_PIN, GND_PIN, RT_MAX_LAYER come from the
shuttle and win), so nothing here may set those keys.
Measured on this design: at 20 MHz (50 ns) the worst corner has +24.7 ns
of setup slack and TNS 0; at 25 MHz (40 ns) the same corner fails by
1.67 ns. 50 is the number the flow actually closed at.
60 is where global placement closed without GPL-0301/GPL-0302. The die
is 76.8 % occupied after resizing, and 85 % + hits route congestion.
Standard hold margins from the template.
A transition limit of 3 ns is ~6 % of the 50 ns period. Tighter values
force cell upsizing that roughly doubles the area for no benefit here.
Keep the linter on: it is what turns a width mismatch into a red X
instead of a mysterious zero at gate level.
Skip the XOR and the second DRC: the shuttle runs them on its side and
they dominated the local run time.
Do not put clock buffers on the outputs.
Absolute die size is set by the shuttle via DIE_AREA + FP_DEF_TEMPLATE.
The shuttle's 2x2 template supplies the grid; RT_MAX_LAYER comes from
the shuttle config, so it is deliberately absent here.
MAGIC_DEF_LABELS causes LVS mismatches with the shuttle's templates.
